kjv: by the plain of the pillar
mine: by the oak of the pillar
note: 'elon mutsav is the oak (terebinth) of the standing stone (cf. Josh 24:26). The KJV's "plain" again follows the Targum.

kjv: wherewith by me they honour God and man
mine: by which gods and men are honored
note: 'elohim in a fable spoken among Canaanite Shechemites, set alongside "men", is more naturally "gods". Same in v. 13 ("cheers gods and men").

kjv: he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily
mine: he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly
note: betormah may mean "deceitfully/secretly" (from mirmah) or be a place name "in Tormah", possibly the Arumah of v. 41.

mine: from the direction of the Diviners' Oak
note: 'elon me'onenim is "the oak of the soothsayers", a sacred tree. It is not a plain.

kjv: and all to brake his skull
note: All to brake (all-to = completely) is obsolete and is often misread as "all to break".
